title: Cordyceps: attack of the killer fungi - Planet Earth Attenborough BBC wildlife
summary: A three-minute clip from BBC's Planet Earth narrated by David Attenborough about Cordyceps, the fungus that infects insects and takes over their behavior. It shows an infected ant and its demise.
why: HN links it as the quick introduction to zombie-ant fungi whenever the topic comes up.

quote.text: For anyone else not familiar with cordyceps fungi, here's a three-minute clip from BCC Planet Earth
